observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon-branded DSLR body with a lens attached; the front grip and Nikon logo are visible.
Photo 1 shows the camera from a different angle with a telephoto zoom lens mounted; lens markings include '70-300mm' and 'AF-P NIKKOR'.
Photo 2 shows the camera and lens from the side; there are visible scuffs/marks on the camera body (especially around the top/side areas).
No photo clearly shows the exact camera model number (e.g., D3400) or the lens model text fully enough to confirm beyond 'AF-P NIKKOR 70-300mm'.

identity.kind: DSLR camera with telephoto zoom lens
identity.model: AF-P NIKKOR 70-300mm (lens marking visible in photo 1)

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera With 70-300mm Lens...
claims.evidence: Photos show a Nikon DSLR and a 70-300mm AF-P NIKKOR lens (photo 1), but the D3400 model designation is not clearly readable in the provided photos.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No photo/video of the camera powering on, autofocus test, shutter count/health, or any functional checks.

risks.risk: Camera body model may not be D3400 (could be another Nikon APS-C DSLR).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number on the camera body (or the menu 'About/Setup' screen showing model).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Nikon DSLR with unknown exact model (worst-case within the shown category).

risks.risk: Lens condition (focus ring/AF-P motor, zoom smoothness, front/rear glass clarity) not verifiable from photos.
risks.proof: Video clip showing autofocus lock on a target at near and far distances + a photo of both front and rear elements in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens not guaranteed for perfect AF/optics (worst-case: treat as needing service/possible issues).

risks.risk: Camera may have cosmetic damage or functional faults (scuffs visible; buttons/ports not testable remotely).
risks.proof: Power-on video showing live view, menu navigation, and that all buttons/dials respond; also a close-up of ports (USB/HDMI) and battery compartment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible faults not confirmed (worst-case: not fully working).

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, straps) not shown.
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (battery + charger + strap + any caps + memory card).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal/uncertain bundle (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing items).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera model (D3400) label or a menu screen showing model name.
Video: power on + live view + autofocus test (near and far) + shutter actuation.
Photos of lens front and rear glass (no haze/fungus/scratches) and a short zoom/focus movement video.
Photo of included items: battery, charger, strap, lens caps, and any memory card.
response.reason: The photos confirm a Nikon DSLR with an AF-P NIKKOR 70-300mm lens, but the exact D3400 model and the 'working perfectly' claim are not verifiable remotely; functional testing and model confirmation are needed before pricing confidently.
